Class SaleVehicle

java.lang.Object
vehicles.Vehicle
vehicles.SaleVehicle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class SaleVehicle extends Vehicle
Represents a vehicle available for sale at a CarDealership.

Extends Vehicle with sale-specific attributes: sale price, discount percentage, and a unique catalogue identifier.

Author:
Juan Carlos Alfaro Jiménez
